items.title: Daily Briefing
items.script: Here is your daily briefing. Over the past month, markets have seen significant changes in oil, AI, and bond trades. While oil prices are expected to rise, treasury yields have fallen, suggesting investors may be more concerned about potential AI industry issues than inflation. Companies like Santander and Novartis report AI is increasing revenue, reducing costs, and improving profits. Investors seeking long-term gains can follow top analysts' recommendations. Data centers are often viewed negatively due to their environmental impact and high energy consumption.
